g.text: Assisted, augmented and automated are three routes through one system,
They are not three stages of production, and they are not a human versus machine split. What changes between them is how much of the sequence AI tasks carry. What never changes is the

Each route needs one agreed sentence and a qualifying rule for
when it is used. Without those, this slide is a shape without content, and the client cannot tell which route their work lands in.
Needed from: whoever holds the brief response. Highest priority open item in this section.
WHY THIS REPLACES THE EARLIER VISUAL
The earlier “human plus tech / fully automated” diagram described the
. It left out briefing and triage, so it read as a
split between people and machines rather than three routes. Routes run brief to delivery. Versioning and translation sit inside the
automated route, not outside the model.
